content:
Former White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt tried to attack Democratic politicians on Monday, but her numbers didn't add up.

She claimed on a Fox News program that Democrats — such as James Talarico, the party's Senate candidate in Texas — are "tremendous hypocrites."

She told Sean Hannity: "They campaign as moderates, do a complete 360 on every single policy position, trying to appeal to common-sense, good Americans. But then once they get elected, they govern as complete radical extreme liberal lunatics."

Campaigning as a moderate, and then doing a "complete 360" on every policy position, would presumably mean governing as a moderate too, since 360 degrees brings you right back to where you started.
